description: The revised Budget proposes AI training from schools to ITIs and colleges, a new AI industry programme, a Rs 2,000-crore laptop scheme, and industry-led skilling initiatives to prepare youth for technology-driven jobs.
body_lead: Artificial intelligence, digital skills and Gen Z-focused initiatives dominated Tamil Nadu revised budget 2026-27, with state unveiling a series of measures aimed at building a future-ready workforce and strengthening its technology ecosystem. State Finance Minister N Marie Wilson on August 5 presented the maiden budget of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)-led coalition government, outlining a roadmap to propel Tamil Nadu towards becoming a $1.5 trillion economy by 2036.
